{{Quote|I remember once, my crèche-mates&mdash;P'loh and Zhul&mdash;we took one of the scrubbing korsks and put it in the communal area. It&mdash;"<br />"Ate all the i'fii. I remember.|Tahiri Veila and Nen Yim talk memories|<ref name="TFP" />}}
'''I'fii''' was a [[Foodstuff/Legends|foodstuff]] [[Diet/Legends|eaten]] by the [[Extragalactic/Legends|extragalactic]] [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. At one [[Time/Legends|time]], future Yuuzhan Vong [[Shaper caste|shaper]] [[Nen Yim]] and [[Gender/Legends|her]] crèche-mates [[P'loh]] and [[Zhul]] stole a [[korsk]] and released it into a communal food area, whereupon the cleaning creature consumed all of the i'fii there.<ref name="TFP">''[[The New Jedi Order: The Final Prophecy]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
I'fii was first mentioned in [[Greg Keyes]]' [[2003]] novel ''[[The New Jedi Order: The Final Prophecy]]''.<ref name="TFP" />

*''[[The New Jedi Order: The Final Prophecy]]'' {{1stm}}
